status: Retrospective reanalysis after prior results were viewed; not preregistered.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of valid rows per participant and period; equal participant weight; retain valid retries.
primary: Between-condition difference in participant changes (late minus early)
secondary: Between-condition difference in participant late means
test: Independent two-sided Welch t-test for each endpoint
multiplicity: Holm across exactly the primary and secondary tests; report both regardless of primary significance.
diagnostics: All participant points and within-group Q-Q plots for both endpoints; no test switching.
missing: Stop if a participant has no valid MT in either period; report missing records without imputation.
